# membership member

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:membershipMember`](gmeow-membershipMember.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/membershipMember>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

The agent whose membership a [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) reifies. Functional — a membership concerns one member (the relator's member role); the flat [`gmeow:memberOf`](gmeow-memberOf.md) is the agent→organization shortcut, this connects the reified relator to its member so role and period can be carried.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:membershipMember`](gmeow-membershipMember.md) from [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
